nodes.name: checkpoint-c-report.md
nodes.summary: Checkpoint C halt-and-PM report for the GEPA Faza 1 benchmark, documenting held-out evaluation results for three prompt candidates and concluding that 2/3 pass the §F.5 overfitting bound while gpt::gen1-v2 is exposed as selection bias; includes per-candidate analysis, §F.2 verdict confirmation, Faza 2 deployment authorization, and PM ratify options.

nodes.name: checkpoint-c-summary.json
nodes.summary: Machine-readable summary of the GEPA Faza 1 Checkpoint C evaluation run, capturing manifest anchors, candidate IDs, held-out instance IDs, per-candidate scores, F.2 verdict confirmation, F.5 overfitting bound, Faza 2 deployment authorization status, and next steps.

nodes.name: final-kappa-audit.json
nodes.summary: Inter-rater reliability audit for the GEPA Faza 1 Checkpoint C evaluation, recording pairwise Cohen's kappa, raw agreement rates, per-judge pass rates, canonical kappa, drift band, and audit metadata to verify judge consistency.
